plugins.name: writing-loop
plugins.description: Runs a script-writing loop coordinated through ticket state on a local file board. Each project keeps its creative charter in the North Star and all reusable season, character, world, continuity, foreshadowing, and timeline facts in two canonical structured JSON documents. Supports autonomous novel-adaptation intake and original creation.
